surface: Showcase Network selection → Save as pattern persistence
reproduction: Capture a GET response whose URL contains a credential-bearing query parameter; use only a harmless synthetic canary in any regression, never a real credential.
Select the response and save with the default exact matcher and URL-derived pattern name.
Inspect the persisted recipe's config and name for the synthetic canary; do not copy or log any real URL or secret.
expected: Before persistence, credential-bearing URL values are removed from saved configuration and name, or saving is refused with a safe remedy. No actual credentials, token values, raw sensitive URLs, or headers are stored or logged. Non-sensitive URL matching remains available, with honest guidance if removing a credential prevents replay.
actual: Selecting a response initializes replayUrlFilter from event.url. Save config stores that matcher, while defaultName includes a shortened form of the selected URL; shortenUrl keeps query text when it fits and may retain the tail of a longer query. SaveAsPattern forwards both fields to savePattern, which persists name and config in the pattern record. No credential redaction or refusal exists in this path.
source_evidence: src/features/showcase/tabs/NetworkTab.tsx:39-45 copies event.url into replayUrlFilter; :287-302 sends savedUrlFilter in config and derives defaultName from shortenUrl(selected.url, 40); :312-321 includes pathname and query in the shortened text.
src/features/showcase/components/SaveAsPattern.tsx:154-166 passes name and config to savePattern.
src/lib/supabase/queries.ts:974-987 inserts name and config into extend.wbx_pattern without URL-value sanitization.
severity: S2: important; credential-bearing request URLs can be durably exposed in recipe configuration and name.
priority: P1: persisted secrets violate the safe-save contract.
verification_status: D41 focused green 30 and types passed on pre-merge .108 source, but the fresh peer found this privacy gap. No real credential was used; no D48-specific test or installed-extension run has been performed.

transition_history.reason: Fresh independent D41 source peer confirmed the selected request URL reaches persisted config and a URL-derived pattern name without sanitization; no actual credential or runtime outcome was used.

closure_requirement: Add a regression with a harmless synthetic canary proving neither config nor name persists sensitive query values, with a safe visible remedy. Then verify the installed Showcase save/reopen UI on a real public page without ever using or recording a real credential.
